main.description: Requests to see a project's press kits, and the grants that answer them. Owned by the Local Network root account, one space per project, keyed by the project record's key. Anyone signed in can write a request into it, and only the root writes grants; only its members (the project's current managers) can read it, so the people asking, and those granted access, never see each other's requests or grants.
main.name: Local Network press kit requests
